item.title: Colonel John W. Ripley, USMC.
item.description: Frank Dirks interviews Norman Fulkerson about his book, An American Knight: The Life of Colonel John W. Ripley, USMC. It is the first cradle-to-grave biography of Colonel Ripley, a great American hero and Catholic gentleman. Recorded December 2025.

item.title: St. Patrick Catholic Church.
item.description: Frank Dirks interviews Fr. John Bosco Ikemeh about the Charleston parish’s long history and current capital campaign. Recorded January 2026.

item.title: Football!
item.description: Frank Dirks interviews Logan Hall, the head coach of the Bishop England High School football team. They discuss the school’s approach to developing student-athletes. Recorded January 2026.

item.title: Science and Swimming.
item.description: Frank Dirks interviews Rose Van Metre, chair of the Science Department and coach of the swim team at Bishop England. They discuss the blend of academics, athletics, and faith for student-athletes. Recorded Feb. 2026.

item.title: Frank Dirks Interviews Dr. Martocchio about Via Fidelis Year 2.
item.description: Frank Dirks interviews Michael Martocchio, Ph.D., Director of Catechesis and Christian Initiation and the Diocesan Board of Catechetical Advisors. They discuss Bishop Fabre-Jeune’s Via Fidelis, Year Two, and the catechetical goal of understanding the Faith. Recorded February 2026

item.title: Catholic Appeal 2026
item.description: Frank Dirks interviews Brian Alberts, Director of Stewardship & Mission Advancement, for the Diocese of Charleston. They discuss the diocese’s annual campaign and where the funds are allocated. Recorded February 2026.

item.title: The Class of 2026.
item.description: Frank Dirks interviews seniors from Bishop England High School. They discuss their time at the school and how it prepared them for their futures. This interview was recorded in February 2026.

item.title: Via Fidelis – Year Two
item.description: Frank Dirks interviews Bishop Jacques Fabre-Jeune about his five-year plan for the Diocese, Via Fidelis, which is now in its second year. This interview was recorded in February 2026.
